BusinessDispatch may route /v1/projects to business CRUD; list visibility is not kernel execution permission. Same database target and separate restricted business/kernel roles must be proven without emitting connection data.

Scoped API node/capacity response and source/image binding
steps.rejectOrRollback: 401 is no authenticated measurement; 403 AUTH-0030 or missing mapping stays HOLD. No copying grants, joining the pre-existing Node or changing another tenant to make counts.

Project association and resource IDs enabled; actual selected browser project matches. This observation is MUTATING: begin inserts nonce; accept updates heartbeat and snapshots. DB receivedAt/observedAt/epoch/profile and bounded CPU/memory offer

Bind exact source, allowed workload image/executable, profile/policy versions, CPU/memory resources, bounded immutable snapshot and allowed working/object roots before writes. Same project ID must agree across public and inv rows; no arbitrary A-to-B translation or fallback.

steps.name: Two real approvals, atomic enqueue, then ONE targeted delivery
steps.requiredRole: Two distinct non-requester current approvers: can_approve and, if business-linked, owner/approver membership. Runtime uses restricted DB role, CP mTLS and independently pinned launch signer; no diagnostic RLS-bypass role.
steps.prerequisite: Actual containment allows execution; fresh runtime.observe occurs outside held DB locks, followed by authority/versions rechecks. Approval consumption, CPU/memory leases, monotone fences, signed permit and durable queue commit atomically. Root must bind command-specific delivery/output scope.
expectedEvidence: Two current distinct votes and fixed actionDigest
Accepted queue with exact Run/start/command/claim/lease fence IDs
One Node execution attempt with actual Docker quota/isolation readback
steps.rejectOrRollback: Before enqueue failure: no consumed approval/lease/queue partial state. Unknown transmission: observe/cancel the SAME command, never issue another start. worker --once CLI has no command selector and may process unrelated tenant work; use the existing command_id-limited function under a scoped grant, not an invented flag or unfiltered tenant worker.

steps.name: Bind physical stop, stdout/exit/artifact and audit before success or release
existingEntry: NodeDelivery receipt observation and DeliveryWorker/output ingestion
steps.requiredRole: Current scoped project reader; authenticated Node stop/result channel and durable output provider.
steps.prerequisite: Result/receipt matches current tenant/Node/epoch/channel/Run/command/attempt/fences/input hash. Output store and audit/event linkage are configured and independently read back; all IDs currently null.
expectedEvidence: Exactly one completed attempt and actual authenticated stopped receipt
Expected sentinel stdout, stderr, exit code, artifact hash and committed result
Same correlation/Run sequence through grants, policy, votes, leases, queue, Node receipt and audit; verified resources released once
steps.rejectOrRollback: No success from HTTP202, container exit alone, host label or missing output. Hold leases/edit locks until authenticated physical stop; reconcile uncertain output by observation without execution replay. Never clear journal/floors, delete volumes/Nodes, restart an old image or clean unrelated work.
